concept: Diagnosing a recurring organizational or personal problem by mapping the actual system, not just reacting to the latest incident
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic recurring problem (team dysfunction, a business bottleneck, a personal pattern) that keeps resurfacing despite repeated fixes
exercise.reflection_prompt: What does the actual system look like here, beyond the latest symptom?
exercise.practice: Adult sketches the real system (inputs, feedback loops, incentives) causing the recurring problem

assessment.success_marker: adult identifies a structural cause, not just the most recent triggering event
